prose: Bloomberg reports Flapping Airplanes, which works on training AI models with less data and compute and on making chips more efficient, has raised $1 billion at a $6 billion valuation. The article could not be fetched, so this summary is limited to the headline.
highlights: Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
Focus: data- and compute-efficient training plus chip efficiency
Source: Rachel Metz, Bloomberg, via Techmeme
basis: Basis: Techmeme headline only; the source fetch failed during a mass outage.
